---
name: Translation Issue
about: Bad translations, translation suggestions.
title: "[TRANSLATION}"
labels: Translation
assignees: Janos42us

---

## Current text
Copy the text as it appears in the game.

## Suggested change
Write your proposed replacement.

## Why change it?
Explain your reasoning: typo, grammar, unclear wording, character voice, translation accuracy, etc.

If you have the original Japanese text or a supporting source, include it here.

## Where does it appear?
Include the location, NPC, conversation, item, spell, or menu.
Mention any steps needed to see the text.

## Screenshot
Drag and drop a screenshot showing the current text.
If available, include a screenshot of the original Japanese too.

## Game version
- **Disc revision:** Rev A / Rev B
- **Patch version:** Full version shown at the bottom right of the title screen.

## Save backup (optional)
Attach a `.bup` save near the text, packed in a `.zip`.
Let us know where to go or what to do after loading it.

## Anything else?
Include any context or related lines that would help us review the suggestion.
